lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with approximately 10-12% torso-length intervals between lines 2 through 5.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal terminus of the second line from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (posterior-most) terminates mid-way down the flank. Lines 6 and 7 (anterior) are abbreviated segments that do not reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three high-contrast white spots are visible on the posterior haunch: a primary pair of circular blobs on the lower haunch and a single smaller satellite spot positioned dorsally to the pair.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two primary lower haunch spots are aligned on a slight posterior-to-anterior diagonal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horn structure follows a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging from the frontal bone with a posterior-dorsal curve before twisting laterally.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The terminal 10% of the visible horn length exhibits high-contrast ivory/white pigmentation relative to the dark base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; distinct white spots on the lower cheek and mandible; presence of a long, dark ventral hair fringe.
